note: Laws the Money Trail follows. Each one has its own USAspending spending code (disaster emergency fund code). follow_laws.py checks every code against USAspending's official list and against the Library of Congress bill record before anything is used. recipients: 'infrastructure' = award search ranked by Infrastructure Obligations, 'disaster' = the disaster recipient page (it counts only the code's dollars; works for COVID-19 codes), 'none' = no public source counts only this law's dollars per recipient.

laws.code_note: Spending code O also carries some CARES Act money, but code O is shared with three other laws, so it is left out.
